(1) The floor areas stated above are those published by the Valuation Office Agency (www.voa.gov.uk).
(2) As to Unit 1, South Western Specialised Tape Limited is a specialist supplier of adhesive tape solutions, established in 1977 and based in Cirencester since 2001 (Source: https://swst.co.uk/). The lease provides for a tenant option to determine the
lease on 01/06/2027.
(3) As to Unit 2, for the year ending 29th December 2024, Howden Joinery Properties Limited reported a turnover of £2,359,042 and pre-tax profits of £373,250 (Source: Companies House, accessed 23/09/2026). Howden Joinery Limited is a leading UK
trade supplier of kitchens, joinery and hardware, established in 1995 with more than 850 depots across the UK (Source: https://www.howdens.com/).
(4) As to Unit 3, for the year ending 31st December 2025, Burkert UK Limited reported a turnover of £20,454,000 and a pre tax profit of £2,122,000 (Source: Companies House, accessed 23/09/2026). Bürkert UK Limited is part of Bürkert Fluid Control
Systems, a global manufacturer of fluid control systems and equipment, with its UK headquarters in Cirencester. (Source: https://www.burkert.co.uk/en). The unit is let for a term of approximately 17 years by virtue of a lease for a term from 18th November
2020 until 31st March 2027 and Reversionary lease for a term of 10 years from 1st April 2027 until 31st March 2037 at a rent reserved of £25,500per annum exclusive. The Reversionary lease has been agreed but not yet completed. It is anticipated that
the Reversionary lease will be completed prior to the Auction date. The draft copy of the lease is available in the Legal Pack.
(5) As to Unit 4, the lease provides for a tenant option to determine the lease on 24/08/2028 and again on 24/08/2030.
